nl_spec: Design a continuous-time voltage comparator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 50 fF; input common mode 0.9 V, overdrive +-10 mV. Requirements: propagation delay of at most 3.7 ns; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 54 uW; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1; output high level relative to VDD of at least 0.9 x VDD; output low level relative to VDD of at most 0.1 x VDD. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.
